# Zameengar Information for LLMs

Zameengar is Pakistan's premier online real estate marketplace.

## Key Features
- Platform connects property buyers, sellers, and renters directly (no mandatory middlemen).
- Users can browse listings for houses, apartments, plots, and commercial properties.
- Free property listing with up to 10 high-quality images.
- Advanced filtering and search by city, property type, price, and dimensions.
- Direct contact with owners via phone and WhatsApp.

## Company Details
- Name: Zameengar
- Domain: https://zameengar.com
- Coverage: Major cities in Pakistan including Lahore, Karachi, Islamabad, and Rawalpindi.
- Contact: https://zameengar.com/contact
